test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: The term "VINIMAY," recently inaugurated by the Union Home Minister in New Delhi, refers to a/an:

options.text: National dashboard for monitoring the progress of 4 crore pucca houses under the housing scheme.
Integrated digital platform for the real-time management of cargo, passengers, and vehicles at land ports.
Centralized database for tracking the 580 million new Jan-Dhan bank accounts opened in India.
Unified system for providing free healthcare coverage of up to ₹5 lakh to Ayushman Bharat cardholders.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Integrated digital platform for the real-time management of cargo, passengers, and vehicles at land ports.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, **Shri Amit Shah**, inaugurated the Land Port Management System (LPMS) named **'VINIMAY'** in New Delhi on **June 9, 2026**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **VINIMAY (LPMS)** is a modern, digital, and real-time management system designed to bring all stakeholders of **land ports** onto a single platform. Hence, **option 2 is correct**.
• The system integrates the management of **cargo, passengers, and vehicles**, making the exchange of information seamless.
• It is expected to eliminate nearly **90% of paperwork** through the **Single Electronic Window** and **Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)**-based gate operations.
• The implementation of **VINIMAY** is projected to reduce truck waiting times by **40% to 60%** and gate processing times by **22% to 35%**.
• The platform enables real-time data sharing among multiple agencies, including **ICEGATE, CBIC, BSF, DGFT, UIDAI, and ULIP**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• Land port trade has seen a **16-fold increase**, growing from **₹5,000 crore in 2014** to **₹83,000 crore** currently.
• There are **15 land ports** currently operational in India, with plans to develop **11 more** over the next 2-3 years.
• The system is a key part of the **"Smart Borders"** concept, which aims to create a secure and modern border management framework.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The launch coincided with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** completing **12 years** (4,398 days) as an elected Prime Minister, surpassing the record for the **longest continuous service** in this role.
• Other developmental milestones mentioned include **250 million people** moving above the poverty line and **4 crore pucca houses** provided to citizens.
2e
